newsitem.title: PERU: Peru troops battle with rebels, soldiers injured.
newsitem.headline: Peru troops battle with rebels, soldiers injured.

text.p: Peruvian troops stormed the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima on Tuesday, fighting with Marxist rebels occupying the building, and three injured soldiers were carried away on stretchers.

Gunfire and explosions were heard repeatedly after troops stormed the residence at 3.20 p.m. local time (2020 GMT). More than 40 hostages, including Peruvian Foreign Minister Francisco Tudela, were taken out, witnesses said.
Soldiers swarmed through private houses behind the residence to storm it on the 126th day of the siege by Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels.
Earlier in the crisis, negotiations between the rebels and President Alberto Fujimori's government to end the crisis peacefully had proved fruitless.
